courses.title: Bereavement Groups and Workshops: Exploring the Grief Journey
courses.description: Experiential grief workshops and groups offered from time to time by Simcha's DA'AT Institute, exploring loss from personal, family and cultural angles through discussion, sharing, reflection, meditation and group process. Open both to mourners and to people who work with the dying and bereaved; dates are given on request.

left_out: Bereavement counselling, grief counselling, hospice support, past life therapy and transpersonal psychotherapy: one-to-one counselling and psychotherapy services; still left out under the scope rule (therapy is not spiritual teaching), not the health rule.
Exploring the Bereavement Journey (New York Open Center professional workshop): dated April 2018, past.
